name: help-anywhere
title: A help flag answered only in first position, and one command that answers nothing
description: Found by running the launcher rather than reading it: of the fourteen commands the router advertises, eight answer their own --help and six answer a usage error, because help is recognised only as the first argument and a group command with no subcommand falls through. One of the eight, rpc, exits 0 with empty output. The fix guards exactly the commands the local CLI owns, so install --help keeps its own argparse help
creator: aixi
